mapper.select: select g.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone, a.nick_name as repaired_by_name from hys_recon_gap g left join hys_member m on m.member_id = g.member_id left join sys_user a on a.user_id = g.repaired_by where g.gap_id = #{gapId}

select g.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone, a.nick_name as repaired_by_name from hys_recon_gap g left join hys_member m on m.member_id = g.member_id left join sys_user a on a.user_id = g.repaired_by where g.order_id = #{orderId}

select g.*, m.name as member_name, m.phone as member_phone, a.nick_name as repaired_by_name from hys_recon_gap g left join hys_member m on m.member_id = g.member_id left join sys_user a on a.user_id = g.repaired_by
and g.status = #{status} and g.member_id = #{memberId} and g.order_id like concat('%', #{orderId}, '%')
order by g.gap_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into hys_recon_gap (order_id, member_id, reason, amount_cents, note, status, repaired_by, repaired_time, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{memberId}, #{reason}, #{amountCents}, #{note}, #{status}, #{repairedBy}, #{repairedTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hys_recon_gap set status = #{status}, repaired_by = #{repairedBy}, repaired_time = #{repairedTime}, note = #{note} where gap_id = #{gapId} and status = 'OPEN'
